See also: Banja and bánja

English

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

banja (plural banjas)

  1. Alternative form of banya.

Anagrams

[edit]
  • Bajan

Chichewa

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Proto-Bantu *kɪ̀bánjá.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈɓá.ⁿd͡ʒa/

Noun

[edit]

bánja class 5 (plural mabánja class 6)

  1. family, specifically one's spouse and children

Dutch

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Russian ба́ня (bánja), from Proto-Slavic *baňa, an old borrowing from Vulgar Latin *bāneum, from Latin balneum.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈbɑn.jaː/
  • Hyphenation: ban‧ja

Noun

[edit]

banja f (plural banja's, diminutive banjaatje n)

  1. banya (Russian sauna)

Finnish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Russian ба́ня (bánja).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈbɑnjɑ/, [ˈbɑ̝njɑ̝]
  • Rhymes: -ɑnjɑ
  • Syllabification(key): ban‧ja
  • Hyphenation(key): ban‧ja

Noun

[edit]

banja

  1. Russian banya

banja

Lower Sorbian

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • bańa (obsolete)

Etymology

[edit]

From Proto-Slavic *baňa.

Noun

[edit]

banja f

  1. bulbous vessel; jug, bucket
  2. pumpkin
  3. (derogatory) head

Declension

[edit]
declension of banja

Genitive banje banjowu banjow

Locative bani banjoma banjach

Serbo-Croatian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Proto-Slavic *baňa. Doublet of banj.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /bâɲa/
  • Hyphenation: ba‧nja

Noun

[edit]

bȁnja f (Cyrillic spelling ба̏ња)

  1. spa, resort (with mineral springs)
    Srbija je zemlja manastira, tvrđava i banja. ― Serbia is a land of monasteries, fortresses and spas.
  2. (regional) bathroom
  3. Turkish bath, steam bath

Declension

[edit]
Declension of banja
singular plural
nominative bȁnja banje
genitive banje bȃnjā
dative banji banjama
accusative banju banje
vocative banjo banje
locative banji banjama
instrumental banjom banjama

[edit]
  • “banja”, in Hrvatski jezični portal [Croatian language portal] (in Serbo-Croatian), 2006–2026

Inherited from Proto-Slavic *baňa. First attested in the 18th century

Pronunciation

Noun

[edit]

bánja f

  1. bath (vessel)

Upper Sorbian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Proto-Slavic *bàňa.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈbanja/
  • Rhymes: -anja
  • Hyphenation: ba‧nja
  • Syllabification: ba‧nja

Noun

[edit]

banja f

  1. pumpkin, gourd, squash (any plant of the genus Cucurbita or its fruit)
    Synonym: kirbs

Declension

[edit]
